title: Payment variable symbol dated by UTC instead of local time
goal: The attached service builds payment variable symbols as {LocationDigit}yyMMdd{NNN} from DateTime.UtcNow.Date, so after midnight Prague time it uses the previous day (until 02:00 in summer, 01:00 in winter). Fix it test-first: first a failing xUnit test (.NET 8), then the fix. Deliver both, in that order, in one Markdown document.
acceptance: The document first shows a test that fails on the current code for 00:30 Europe/Prague in summer and in winter.
The fix injects the time (TimeProvider or an equivalent) and uses no static DateTime.Now or DateTime.UtcNow.
A test documents what happens after sequence number 999 in one day.
The tests use an in-memory database helper, not a real database.
For 2026-07-15T22:30Z the expected symbol continues with 260716 after the location digit.
key: For UTC 2026-07-15T22:30Z (00:30 in Prague) the date part is 260716, not 260715.
